clusters.name: Your grandfather Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Walter's move of the family to Sorrel Valley in March 1952, within the following year and a half: June and her sister Edna's homesickness, Walter and June's distance out among the trees, Glen's fights at the new school, Walter's stopping speaking to his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June's weeks kept to her bed, and the rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, with things settling by September 1953 when June joined the church choir; Faye's stomach aches and Roy's being kept back a year sit on dates nobody is sure of, so they are weighed lightly rather than placed in the name.

clusters.name: Your grandfather Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Walter's orchard failing in May 1968 and its sale that October: his heavy drinking, his conflict with Glen over the loan, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money, Carl's worse asthma, Walter's stopping speaking to Roy, Carl's asthma easing in the same month as Nora's bedwetting starting again, and Ida's heart trouble that spring, with things settling by the autumn of 1969 when Walter stopped drinking and Glen found new work driving for the feed store.

clusters.name: Your father Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around your father Glen losing his job when the cannery closed in February 1975, within the following year: his months out of work, loud fights with Marian over money, Marian and Glen's second job cleaning offices at night, Nora's not eating, Carl's staying away most nights at his girlfriend's family's house, Nora's keeping to her room, Walter's drinking again, and Tess's nightmares, with things settling by the spring of 1976 when Glen found work driving a delivery truck and Nora was eating again and made the track team.

clusters.name: Your partner's mother Wilma's move into the house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around your partner's mother Wilma selling her farm and moving into the house in January 1990, within the following year and a half: the clashes between Nora and Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis's working late and keeping out of the kitchen rows, Hollis's taking his mother's side, Owen's tantrums at preschool, Wilma's taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema, the nightly rows between Nora and Hollis, and Marian's driving over to take Nora's side, with things settling once Wilma took a flat in town in June 1991 and the eczema cleared that summer.
